title: docs(skills): View All and Modify All open no field in the ai and data skills (19 meaning)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao8nHma7nVQAd7MRuNZUEQa3)_

Fixes #37374

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：照技能写应用的 AI 不再说「全部修改能改被锁住的字段、能盖过字段隐藏」，改说 19 的含义：全部查看和全部修改只放宽能碰到哪些记录，不开任何字段。
- 为什么做：这是「19 版把记录权限和字段权限拆开」那件事的收尾，对外发布的技能文字要和已经合并的行为一致。
- 出错会怎样：只改说明文字和评测标准答案，运行行为不变；万一写错，AI 会给出不对的字段权限建议，撤回本次合并即可恢复。
- 要你做什么：请批准本次合并。改动里带了技能字数上限表三行的下调，按规则这一类要你点头。

## What changes

Ruling of record 7177220994, landed by PR 37371: from 19, View All (`viewAllRecords`) and Modify All (`modifyAllRecords`) widen records only and cast no field vote; `viewAllFields` is the one "every field" bit. Every View All / Modify All sentence under `skills/**` was re-read against `PermissionEvaluator.getFieldPermissions` on `origin/main` f19ae3a8. Four texts taught the meaning before 19:

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, pitfall 2. Before: a field permission without `editable` "binds only a caller no held set grants it, and Modify All grants it, so an admin's agent still writes the field". After: it binds every caller none of whose sets grants the field with an `editable: true` row, and Modify All is no such grant.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, roll-up visibility. Before: mask the summary "after removing any Modify All it holds on the parent (it overrides the mask)". After: mask the summary. The mask binds beside Modify All.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json`, case 20 (the eval of the sentence above): the expected output no longer asks for "no Modify All on `project` (it overrides the mask)".
- The same file, case 37: the expected output said another set's View All or Modify All re-opens a field hidden by a `readable: false` row, and that `requiredPermissions` is what stops the managers' Modify All. It now says the re-opening votes are a `readable: true` row or `viewAllFields`, and that Modify All opens no field from v19.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`, high-sensitivity fields: `requiredPermissions` is "strictest-wins over every field row and `viewAllFields`". View All and Modify All leave that list. The old sentence was not false, but it named them among field votes, three lines of teaching away from "from v19 they open no field". This is the one edit beyond the two files the card names, beside `relationships.md`; say so and it goes back.

Left as they are, because they are the record axis and still true: `security.md` Three axes and the `owner_only_deletes` bullet, the `viewAllRecords` posture bullet, `relationships.md` on a detail row with no master, `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` on a queue move, and eval cases 36 and 38.

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: three rows follow their files down to the measured count (the gate reds on a row left above its measurement). No row rises.

## Tests

Prose and one ceilings table; no tested behaviour changes, so no ablation. Local readings at head a788fbfb:

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`: exit 0, the three rows at headroom 0. Its `--self-test`: exit 0, "111 cases pass".
- The eval file parses as JSON; only the three expected-output strings moved.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch order named eval lines near 373 and 383. Case 37 (line 373) is corrected. Case 38 (line 383) teaches Modify All lifting the owner-only delete floor on a `private` object, which is the record axis and holds on `origin/main`; it is unchanged.
- Tier: the diff carries `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` beside `skills/**`, and the governed register's own self-test pins that pair as Tier H ("skills-plus-a-gate-script-or-a-lockfile-stays-H"). The row lowering cannot be left out: the ratchet reds on a row above its file's measurement.
- Case 37's prompt still gives the managers Modify All. It is a fair distractor under 19, so the prompt is unchanged.

## Verification

First file to read: `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md`, the pitfall 2 hunk (the one sentence an agent acts on when it locks a field). Then `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md`, then the two expected outputs.

Two-minute check: `git grep -n -i "modify all\|view all" -- skills/` and read each hit; none says either bit opens, edits or re-opens a field.

<details><summary>Local gates at head a788fbfb</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: "68 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 66 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED (2 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". The 66 exited 0.

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`, reason: both ask for a whole-workspace build this prose diff does not otherwise need (exit 3, prerequisite not met). CI runs them.
- 46 of the 66 ran at 095abd43, before the ratchet rows were lowered; no file they read changed after it. The ratchet family, `check:published-files`, the changeset gate and the 18 families the script edit added ran at a788fbfb.
- `packages/spec/scripts/platform-catalog.test.ts` names the ratchet script in a comment only; it was not run.

</details>
